what_this_is: Every bank C-token whose STORED reading (the Sudachi reading that also builds sentence.kana (I2) and, through token romaji, sentence.romaji (I3)) contradicts its context. One row per token to change. class=mechanical: rule-certain (counter table, 何 rule, digit-wise numerals, or a verified ruling that names the reading). class=review: needs a human (identifier numbers, 何にする-type colloquial variants, rulings that call the other reading 'also possible'). A row whose new_reading holds '|' is unresolved.
replay: 1. For each row: SELECT the token by (sentence slug, position, split_mode='C'); refuse unless surface==row.surface and reading==row.old_reading.
2. SET token.reading=new_reading, token.romaji=new_romaji. If a_tokens is present, rewrite the split_mode='A' tokens at the same position in order (a_tokens_manual=true: re-split by hand).
3. For each sentence in `sentences`: refuse unless sentence.kana==kana_old and sentence.romaji==romaji_old; SET kana=kana_new, romaji=romaji_new; apply neighbor_romaji (position -> [old,new]) if any.
4. Assert I2 (kana==concat C readings) and I3 (romaji==concat C romaji) on every touched sentence, then re-export.

5. Rebuild consumers that copy readings: build_speaking_path.py (production accepted_variants), build_exam_banks.py (cf:n5:3820:1341 fails reading_link_ok after the fix), and review the conjugation examples in items_citing_the_old_reading_record.

rules.nani: bare 何: なん before counters/units, copula (です/だ/でしょう), の, と, て, ら; なに before を/が/も/か/より/に(+non-する), before ？ or sentence end, before a bare verb (particle dropped), before する; 何+で left alone (なんで/なにで both standard); 何駅 left alone; 何+学部/語/色 -> なに.
rules.nani-itsu: 何時 stored いつ/なんどき where the Layer-A English says 'what time' -> なんじ (mechanical); 'how late' or only the pt 'que horas' -> review. なんじ is never flipped to いつ.
rules.counter: numeral (kanji or digits) + counter: full number reading (no digit-by-digit), sound changes from a counter table (本/杯/匹 h-class, 分/発/泊, 個/回/階 k-class, 冊/歳/週間 s-class, 点/頭/等 t-class, 時/時間/月/年/人/円 special 4/7/9, native つ, 晩/切れ/束 ひと/ふた, 日 day table; 一日 ついたち only with N月/毎月/'the 1st' context). Split across tokens the way the bank already does (number token takes the prefix, counter token the tail: つい|たち, はつ|か, いっ|ぽん).
rules.number-digitwise: a digit numeral >=10 read digit by digit with no counter after it -> full reading; review when the sentence is about a number/code/phone/flight.
rules.juu-throughout: 〜中 'all over' after 体/家/国/部屋/一日… stored ちゅう -> じゅう; 一+日中(にっちゅう) -> 一日中 にちじゅう.
rules.verified-link: the token's link was verified by a token_link ruling (or the karada-written-身体 census) and the stored reading is not a reading of that record; new reading = the record reading the ruling names. Rulings that call the stored reading 'also valid' are dismissed, 'also possible / same meaning / variant' -> review.
rules.verified-pattern: a bank link failing exactly like a verified ruling on the same record (inflected forms only).
rules.ruling-text: a verified ruling names the reading of a token that has no record (后 きさき, 直に じかに, 何箱 なんはこ).
